# sapintegrationsuite_message_mapping (Data Source)

Reads an existing reusable Cloud Integration message mapping artifact's metadata by ID. This is the package-level artifact, not an integration flow's inline/local message mapping configuration — see docs/resource-design.md.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sapintegrationsuite_message_mapping" "customer" {
  package_id = "UTILITIES"
  mapping_id = "customer-mapping"
}

output "customer_message_mapping_version" {
  value = data.sapintegrationsuite_message_mapping.customer.version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mapping_id` (String) The message mapping's technical ID.
- `package_id` (String) ID of the integration package the message mapping belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the form "<package_id>/<mapping_id>".
- `name` (String) The message mapping's display name.
- `version` (String) The design-time version SAP reports for this message mapping.
